1.consolidated_definition: Recorrer la sabana donde se ha establecido un hato, para buscar y reunir el ganado, o para vigilarlo.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To traverse the savanna where a cattle ranch has been established, in order to search for and gather livestock, or to monitor it.
